text:
maria_cs: FYI ElmStreet week0 dry-run uncovered a couple infra gotchas: BGP ASN mismatch with their colo and an MTU fragmentation issue on the privlink. Also they asked about BYOK vs AWS-managed KMS. Need quick triage before tomorrow's smoke. @sanjay_se @elliot_infra @audrey_security

sanjay_se: saw the BGP logs. Elm provided ASN 65010 but our peering profile used 65001. We can update our side but need to confirm ASN+password from their NOC. Also MTU: their edge is 1500 but our tunnel encaps adds overhead; suggest set tunnel MTU to 1400 to avoid fragmentation.

elliot_infra: agree on MTU. I'll patch the tunnel config and run an iperf/mtu test. ETA 2h. For BGP, changing our ASN is trivial, but if customer expects us to keep 65001 we can NAT at the peer temporarily. Any preference?

maria_cs: prefer not to change customer expectation. Sanjay, do temporary NAT so cutover stays on schedule, but note in runbook to revert.

audrey_security: KMS: they want BYOK (customer-supplied key material) but also want rotation constraints and cross-account decrypt for their security role. BYOK implies extra provisioning steps and a compliance review. If they insist on BYOK + HSM, provisioning lead time ~6 business days and we need their HSM thumbprint and KMS external key origin.

amanda_am: flagging renewal risk: if BYOK delays >3 business days we escalate and capture in account health. Maria, please log the risk timestamp.

ryan_prod: audit logs — customer wants Splunk HEC ingest over TLS. We'll forward VPC flow + API audit logs to a SIEM collector in their VPC via an ingest endpoint. For week0, set sampling to 100% and wire in a 24/7 retention alert for any gap >5m. Also will enable extra verbose auth logging for initial 48h.

AuditAgent: AuditAgent: detected elevated auth error rate from smoke instances at 6888899021. Logged as event E-ALERT-774.

maria_cs: thanks. action list consolidated: 
- network: apply tunnel MTU 1400 + temporary NAT for BGP mismatch; confirm final ASN with customer (owner: sanjay_se)
- infra: run iperf/mtu test + document rollover steps (owner: elliot_infra)
- security: start BYOK feasibility checklist, request HSM/thumbprint, propose fallback AWS-KMS policy if BYOK blocked (owner: audrey_security)
- obs: configure Splunk HEC endpoint, 100% sampling week0, retention alerts (owner: ryan_prod)
- AM: monitor BYOK lead time and set renewal-risk if >3bd (owner: amanda_am)

elliot_infra: ran iperf: pings show 1420 MTU works, 1500 drops fragments. Posted trace: https://ci.reddemo/elmstreet/mtu/23

audrey_security: attaching sample permissive KMS policy to share with customer (redacted):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowCustomerSecurityRole",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": ["arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/ElmSecurity"]},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
If BYOK accepted, we add an external key policy and schedule rotation to 90d as requested. Otherwise default to AWS-KMS with cross-account role.

amanda_am: please note decision deadline EOD tomorrow. If BYOK not confirmed by then we fallback to AWS-KMS and continue. That's the renewal-risk mitigation.

DeployBot: DeployBot: dry-run elmstreet-smoke-12 completed (logs: https://ci.reddemo/elmstreet/smoke/12)  status: partial-pass (auth errors).

maria_cs: partial pass is ok for now but we need auth error root cause. @audrey_security @elliot_infra can you pair on auth logs and feed me a short summary by 0900? If unresolved >24h escalate to eng-oncall and AM.

audrey_security: will pull CloudTrail + KMS logs and correlate. ETA 3h.

elliot_infra: will check instance-time skew and nginx proxy MTU path. I suspect fragments causing auth timeouts on token exchange.

maria_cs: great. I'll update Confluence runbook with the tasks and ping ElmStreet for ASN, HSM thumbprint, and Splunk HEC URL. Reconvene in 4h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
